reviews.text: Our outdoor kitchen turned out better than anything we imagined. They handled the water lines, drainage, outlets, and built a beautiful cover over the whole area. The concrete work is smooth and clean with no imperfections.

They took our old patio and transformed it into a fully functional space. The new cover ties right into the roofline, the slab looks brand new, and they installed plumbing and electrical exactly where we needed them for our kitchen setup.
We asked for a shaded kitchen area, and they delivered exactly that. The patio cover looks great, the concrete is spotless, and all the plumbing and electrical hookups function exactly how we wanted.
The craftsmanship on the framing of our patio roof is incredibly precise — every beam is perfectly aligned and anchored.
